### Requirements

- [Nerd fonts](https://www.nerdfonts.com/)

- [Rxfetch](https://github.com/mngshm/rxfetch)
- [Colorls](https://github.com/athityakumar/colorls)

#### Restore all backups

To restore al configuraction you need to clone the repository

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Troy8203/Restore-Scripts.git
cd Restore-Scripts
./main.sh
```
